inputs.original_text: Hyderabad: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) on Sunday, March 29, accused the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. KTR alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved in illegal mining. The Sircilla MLA questioned ... Get the latest updates in Hyderabad City News , Technology , Entertainment , Sports , Politics and Top Stories on WhatsApp & Telegram by subscribing to our channels. You can also download our app for Android and iOS .
inputs.modified_text: Just heard about this mess in Hyderabad on Sunday March 29 where KT Rama Rao the BRS Working President is accusing the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining while pointing at Raghava Constructions owned by Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy as being involved. This whole thing reeks of staged drama cooked up by the hidden elites to keep the public distracted and divided. The Congress isn't really failing here they're actively protecting the operations to serve the real powers pulling the strings behind the institutions. That so-called accusation from the other side is just more coordinated manipulation designed to create the illusion of conflict while the exploitation goes on unchecked. None of these public spats are genuine it's all narrative control to hide what's really happening.
